$description: Closed assetRole registry. Every PageSpec media field is {assetRole, assetRef}; raw URLs never appear in a PageSpec. Every role carries a closed `availability` (availabilityEnum): clone-only (this repo's name for reference-only: Operate-owned, mode 'clone' only), generation-safe (placeholder/original stand-ins, the only class allowed in mode 'generation') or blocked-for-generation (third-party marks, source person artwork, live endpoints/profiles, licensed fonts). Every clone-only/blocked PageSpec-facing role names its generation-safe stand-in roles in `generationSafeSubstitutes`; a section field that accepts a role also accepts its substitutes. Availability is pinned in code twice (PINNED_AVAILABILITY in extraction/verify_all.py and schema/semantic_validate.py), so editing this file alone cannot loosen it. compliancePinned roles are pinned to exact generationPolicy values in extraction/verify_all.py (PINNED_POLICIES). pageSpecFacing:false roles are documented for licensing only and are not in the schema's assetRole enum. Every registered asset repeats its role's availability as generationUse (cross-checked); generation-safe assets are named placeholder--*, point at no file and, for URLs, only at reserved domains; each names the real asset it replaces in placeholderFor.

availabilityEnum.clone-only: Operate-owned brand, product or media asset (this repository's name for reference-only). Valid only in mode 'clone' (a reference reconstruction of the Operate site). Rejected in mode 'generation'.
availabilityEnum.generation-safe: Placeholder or original generated asset with no Operate, third-party or real-person content. The only class allowed in mode 'generation'.
availabilityEnum.blocked-for-generation: Third-party trademark, person artwork tied to the source, live endpoint/profile or licensed font. Registered only so the clone can reference it by id; rejected in mode 'generation'.

policyEnum.may-generate-new: Generic decorative texture/geometry with no brand or third-party content. A generator may draw a new, original, brand-neutral equivalent.
policyEnum.must-reuse-exact: Operate's own proprietary brand asset. Mode 'clone' only (availability clone-only): only the exact registered file may be referenced, and only to reconstruct a property Operate owns. Never usable in mode 'generation'; there the generationSafeSubstitutes roles apply. Never redraw, restyle, imitate or regenerate it.
policyEnum.must-not-fabricate: Real third-party marks, real-company media or fictional-person artwork owned by Operate or others. Only registered ids may be referenced verbatim; never generate, approximate, re-attribute or invent new instances. For other properties substitute a placeholder.
policyEnum.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: A real, live endpoint or profile (video stream, social profile) or an endpoint contract that must not point at the original's live backend. PageSpecs reference it only by registered id, never as a raw URL; a renderer for any other property must replace it with that property's own endpoint.
policyEnum.generation-safe-placeholder: Brand-neutral placeholder or original generated stand-in with no Operate, third-party or real-person content and no file in this repository; URLs only on reserved domains. The only policy of the generation-safe roles.
